Busca dados reais do TJSP:
```{python}
tjsp = jus.scraper("tjsp")
dados = tjsp.cjpg("Serasa", paginas=range(1, 10))
dados.shape
```

```{python}
(
    p9.ggplot(dados, p9.aes(x="assunto"))
    + p9.geom_bar()
    + p9.coord_flip()
)
```
